values: This is your All-in-One Personal Productivity suite. It combines Habit tracking, Finance management, Task organization, and Note-taking into a single, offline-first application.
All-in-One is an integrated workspace for your life. Manage your money, your routines, your tasks, and your thoughts in one private, secure place.
It's a privacy-first productivity hub. I help you stay on top of your finances, habits, notes, and tasks without ever sending your data to the cloud.
Habits are daily or recurring routines you want to build. You can track your consistency, see streaks, and monitor your long-term discipline in the Habits section.
In this app, habits represent the small actions you repeat to build a better life. We track your progress, streaks, and frequency to help you stay consistent.
The Habits section is for building routines. Whether it's drinking water or meditation, you can track how often you succeed and maintain your momentum.
Tasks are one-off items you need to get done. You can organize them with subtasks, set priorities, and add reminders so you never miss a deadline.
Think of the Tasks section as your master To-Do list. It supports subtasks, priority levels, and reminders to help you execute your daily plan.
Tasks are individual goals or chores. Unlike habits, they are typically completed once. You can categorize them and set deadlines for better focus.
The Finance section helps you track your income and expenses, set monthly budgets, and visualize your spending patterns to reach your savings goals.
Our finance tool is a private ledger for your money. Track every dollar, set budgets for different categories, and see your financial health through automated graphs.
Manage your money better with the Finance module. Log what you spend and earn, monitor your budget, and work towards your long-term savings targets.
Notes are for capturing your ideas, thoughts, or project details. You can use them for everything from simple lists to detailed roadmaps.
The Notes section is your creative canvas. Use it for journaling, brainstorming ideas, or storing important information securely on your device.
Notes help you offload your mental load. Capture quick thoughts, write long-form journals, or document your project roadmaps here.
Projects allow you to group related notes and tasks. Use them to track major milestones and see the overall progress of your big goals.
A project is a high-level goal that requires multiple steps. You can link tasks and notes to it, and track its progress through sub-features.
Use Projects for your big missions. It combines tasks, ideas, and resources into a single view to help you manage complex goals effectively.
I am your built-in Personal Assistant. I live entirely on your device and use local intelligence to help you manage your life more effectively.
I'm your local AI companion. I don't live in the cloud—I live right here on your phone to help you stay organized and private.
Your private AI assistant. My job is to analyze your productivity patterns and help you manage your habits, finances, and tasks.
Yes! This app is 100% offline. All your data stays on your phone, and all my AI processing happens locally. No internet required.
Absolutely. You can use every feature of this app in the middle of a desert without a signal. Your privacy is guaranteed by our offline-first design.
Offline by default. We don't have a backend server, so your data never leaves your device. This makes the app fast, secure, and always available.

keys: what can you do for me
values: I can help you add habits, log expenses, create tasks, search through your notes, and provide personalized insights based on your progress.
Ask me to 'Add habit', 'Create task', or 'Log expense'. I can also find your notes or tell you how your productivity is trending this week.
I'm here to streamline your life. I can handle data entry via voice, provide discipline scores, and help you navigate the app's many features.
Just say 'Add habit' followed by the name, or go to the Habits section and tap the '+' button!
You can create one by saying 'New habit [name]' or by navigating to the Habit Tracker and using the quick-add button.
Tell me 'Start a habit for [name]' and I'll walk you through the setup, or do it manually in the Habits section.
Tell me 'Log 50 expense' or tap the '+' button in the Finance section. You can also categorize it for better tracking.
Just say 'Log [amount] expense' to quickly record spending. For more details, use the 'Add Transaction' button in the Finance area.
Expenses can be added by voice—'Log 500 for food'—or manually in the Finance section using the '+' icon.
Say 'Add task' followed by your task name. You can even add subtasks by saying 'with subtasks' followed by a list!
Create a task by telling me 'Remind me to [task name]'. You can add deadlines and priority levels in the Task section.
Tap the '+' icon on the home screen for a quick task, or say 'Add task [name]' to save it to your master list.
The Intelligent Feed analyzes your data to show you momentum alerts, spending forecasts, and mood-productivity correlations.
It's your AI dashboard. I look for patterns in your habits and finances to give you actionable advice for the day ahead.
Check the Intelligent Feed for your daily briefing. I summarize your top priorities and highlight any risks to your project deadlines.
Go to Settings -> Appearance -> Theme. You can choose between Light, Dark, or OLED modes.
Head to the Settings menu and look for Appearance. You can customize the accent color and the overall background theme there.
Customize your look in Settings! Switch to OLED mode for deep blacks or pick a vibrant accent color that fits your style.
You can use the search bar on the home screen or ask me to 'Search notes for...' followed by your query.
Tap the search icon in the top bar to find anything across tasks, habits, and notes instantly.
Search is global. Type your query into the home screen search bar to see results from every section of the app.
Extremely private. We don't have servers. Your data is stored in an encrypted database on your device and never leaves it.
Your privacy is our core mission. We use local encryption and zero cloud storage to ensure you are the only one who can access your data.
No one—including the developers—can see your data. It's locked behind your device's security and stored 100% locally.
In the Habits section, long-press a habit card or tap the delete icon to remove it from your routine.
Go to the Habit Tracker, open the habit details or long-press the card to find the delete option.
To remove a habit, navigate to its section and use the archive or delete function found in the long-press menu.
A streak represents how many consecutive days you've completed a habit. The higher the streak, the stronger the routine!
Streaks track your daily consistency. Completing a habit every day builds your streak; missing a day resets it (unless you use a grace day).
Your streak is a visual indicator of your discipline. It shows how many days in a row you've successfully performed a habit.
Tell me 'Set budget to 1000' or navigate to the Finance section and use the budget settings option.
In the Finance section, tap on the settings icon to set your monthly budget for different categories or your overall total.
Set your spending limits by saying 'My budget is [amount]' or by updating the budget field in the Finance module.
Go to Finance -> Add Transaction and select 'Income', or just tell me 'Log 5000 income'.
You can record earnings by saying 'Log [amount] income'. I'll add it to your monthly total and update your savings forecast.
Tap the '+' in Finance and toggle the type to 'Income' to track your money coming in.
Navigate to the Projects section and tap '+'. You can add tasks and sub-features to track complex goals step-by-step.
Start a project to organize your big goals. Link relevant notes and tasks to keep everything related to that mission in one place.
Projects are for long-term objectives. Add a title, a deadline, and then start populating it with sub-features and linked notes.
You can log your daily mood on the Home screen. I use this to see how your mood impacts your productivity over time.
Mood tracking helps me find your 'Success Drivers'. Log how you feel every day to see patterns in your energy and discipline.
Use the mood emojis on the home screen to record your state of mind. Over time, I'll show you how your mood correlates with your habit completion.
Go to Settings -> Data Management -> Export. This creates a file you can use to backup or move your data.
Export your data from the settings menu to keep a personal backup. You can use this file to restore your data on a new device.
Backing up is easy: head to Settings, then Data Management, and tap Export to save your database as a JSON file.
Go to Settings -> Data Management -> Import and select your previously exported backup file.
To restore your data, use the Import tool in settings and browse for your All-in-One backup JSON file.
If you have a backup file, you can restore your entire history through the Import option in the Data Management settings.

keys: can i use this on multiple devices
values: Since we are offline-first for privacy, there is no automatic cloud sync. You can move your data manually using Export/Import.
Manual sync is possible by exporting your data on one device and importing it on another. We don't use the cloud to keep your data 100% private.
We prioritize privacy over cloud sync. To use multiple devices, you'll need to manually transfer your backup files.
When adding a task, you can pick a date and time for a reminder. Make sure the app has notification permissions enabled!
Reminders can be set during task creation. I'll send you a notification at the exact time you specify to keep you on track.
Don't forget a thing! Set a reminder when you create a task, and I'll alert you via your device's notification system.
Subtasks are smaller steps for a larger task. You can check them off individually to track progress towards the main goal.
Break complex tasks into manageable subtasks. This makes big goals less intimidating and provides more frequent dopamine hits.
Use subtasks to outline the specific actions needed to finish a major task. You can manage them directly inside the task details.
When logging an expense, you can choose from categories like Food, Transport, or Bills. Manage these in Finance Settings.
Categorization helps you see where your money goes. Pick from our defaults or create your own custom categories in the settings.
Organize your spending by category! You can assign icons and colors to each category to make your financial charts easier to read.
While we don't have a dedicated Pomodoro timer yet, you can track 'Focus' as a habit to build the routine of deep work.
Use 'Deep Work' as a habit to track your focus sessions. We're constantly evolving, so stay tuned for more dedicated focus tools!
Focus is a skill you can build. Try setting a timer on your device and logging the session as a 'Focus' habit here afterward.
Most sections have a 'History' icon in the top bar. You can view your daily, weekly, or monthly progress there.
Tap the history button in any module (Habits, Tasks, Finance) to see a detailed breakdown of your past performance.
Your data is archived automatically. Use the history views to look back at your streaks, spending, and completed projects.
The app's aura color changes based on your current mood and productivity levels, reflecting your daily 'energy'.
Aura colors are a visual representation of your day. They shift based on what you've logged in the mood tracker and your task completion.
Look at the aura glow in the AI section—it reflects your current productivity state and mood, giving the app a personalized feel.
Just tap the checkmark on the habit card in the Habits section, or tell me 'Mark habit [name] as completed'.
Check off a habit by tapping its card or saying 'Habit [name] done'. I'll update your streak and consistency score immediately.
Marking a habit as done is easy! Use the checkbox in the Habit Tracker or tell me via voice to log your success.
Completed tasks can be archived or hidden. Check your Task Settings to decide how you want them displayed.
Archive tasks to keep your list clean. You can toggle visibility for completed and archived items in the Task module settings.
Once a task is done, you can archive it to remove it from your immediate focus while still keeping it in your history.
Absolutely! Tap the microphone icon on the home screen or in the AI section to talk to me directly.
Voice commands are fully supported for all major actions. Just hit the mic and say what you want to add or track.
I love hearing from you! Use the voice button for hands-free logging of habits, expenses, tasks, and notes.
This shows your overall consistency across all domains—habits, tasks, and workouts—over time.
Discipline scores weigh your success in every module. It's a high-level view of how well you're sticking to your overall life system.
Check your performance history to see a bird's-eye view of your productivity trends across the entire app.
In the Notes section, you can add and manage categories to keep your thoughts organized by topic.
Create custom categories for your notes to keep your ideas, journals, and roadmaps separate and easy to find.
Organize your thoughts by adding categories in the Notes section. You can then filter your list to see only what's relevant.
The Personal Ledger helps you track money you owe or others owe you. Manage multiple ledgers for friends or business.
Use the ledger to keep track of debts and loans. It's a simple way to remember who owes you money and what you need to pay back.
Ledgers are dedicated tracking sheets for interpersonal or business debts. You can have multiple ledgers for different people or projects.
Go to Finance Settings -> Currency. You can choose from various symbols like $, £, €, or ₹.
Choose your preferred currency symbol in the Finance module's settings to match your local region.
Navigate to Finance Settings to switch between different currency symbols for all your money tracking.
Inside any Project, you can add 'Sub-features' which act as specific milestones for that project's completion.
Sub-features are the building blocks of a project. Add them to track individual components of a larger goal.
Track complex missions by breaking them into sub-features. Each one represents a milestone toward your final project objective.
Velocity is a measure of how many tasks you complete per day. I use this to help predict if you'll hit your project deadlines.
Your task velocity shows your work speed. It's calculated from your completion history and helps estimate future timelines.
I track your daily task output as 'Velocity'. This allows me to forecast when your active projects are likely to be finished.
Go to Settings -> Security. You can enable a PIN lock or Biometric authentication to protect your private data.
Enable App Lock in the Security settings to require a PIN or fingerprint every time you open the application.
Secure your data by setting up a PIN or using biometrics. You'll find these options in the main Security menu.
The Workspace is a dedicated area for managing complex projects, combining notes, tasks, and sub-features in one view.
Our Workspace feature integrates your project details, related tasks, and brainstorming notes into a single cohesive dashboard.
Use the Workspace for deep focus on one project. It brings together all relevant info so you don't have to switch between tabs.
You can clear specific sections in their settings, or perform a full factory reset in Settings -> Data Management.
To start fresh, head to Data Management and select 'Factory Reset'. This will wipe everything permanently.
Warning: Factory reset deletes all data. If you just want to clear one section, check that section's specific settings instead.
This app is free to use. There are no hidden subscriptions because we believe your productivity tools shouldn't be a burden.
All-in-One is completely free. We don't have a premium tier—every single feature is available to every user from day one.
No ads, no subscriptions, no cost. This is a private tool built for the community to manage their lives better.
When creating a new note, you can select from various templates like 'Meeting Minutes' or 'Journal Entry' to save time.
Templates provide a pre-set structure for your notes. Choose one when you tap the '+' button in the Notes section.
Save time with note templates! Whether it's a daily log or a project outline, we have structures ready for you to fill in.
If you're on a multi-day streak, I'll send you an alert to encourage you to keep it going!
Momentum alerts are my way of cheering you on. If you're doing great with your habits, I'll notify you to maintain the energy.
I'll ping you when your momentum is high or if you're about to lose a long streak. My goal is to keep you consistent.
Navigate to the Workouts section and tap '+'. You can track reps, sets, or time-based exercises.
Log your training by saying 'Add workout [name]' or using the '+' button in the workout tracker.
Training logged! You can track your sets, reps, and even set rest timers inside the Workout module.
I analyze your spending habits to predict if you'll stay within your budget for the rest of the month.
Check your finance charts for a forecast. I look at your daily average to estimate your total monthly expenditure.
My finance engine predicts your end-of-month balance based on your current spending patterns and active budget.
Go to Settings -> Appearance. You can choose which sections (Habits, Finance, Tasks, etc.) are visible on your home screen.
Your home screen is yours to build. Toggle different modules on or off in the Appearance settings.
Only want to see Finance and Tasks? No problem. Customize your home screen visibility in the main Settings menu.
As you complete more habits and tasks, you'll earn milestones that celebrate your growing self-discipline.
Milestones are your productivity 'Level Ups'. Reach certain completion totals to unlock badges and increase your rank.
Track your growth through discipline milestones. Each one marks a significant step in your journey toward total self-mastery.
Open any project and tap the '+' icon in the Sub-features section to add a new milestone.
Milestones (sub-features) can be added inside a project to break it down into smaller, checkable phases.
To add a new step to your roadmap, open the project and use the sub-feature list to create a new milestone.
Your priority score is calculated based on a task's age, its set priority level, deadlines, and subtasks.
Priority scores help you focus. I calculate them automatically to show you which tasks are most urgent and impactful.
I use an algorithm to score your tasks. Higher scores mean the task is older, has higher priority, or has a closer deadline.
Task velocity tracks how many items you complete over time. I use this to estimate how much work you can handle.
Understand your work capacity with Velocity. It's a moving average of your daily task completions.
I track how fast you finish tasks as 'Velocity'. This metric is key for predicting if you'll hit your project deadlines.
By comparing your current task velocity with the remaining work, I can estimate if you will finish before your deadline.
Forecasting uses your historical work speed to predict future completion dates for your active projects.
I'll let you know if a project is at risk by analyzing your remaining sub-features against your recent daily output.
Bulk mode allows you to select multiple tasks at once to move, delete, or mark them as completed.
Use bulk actions in the Task section to organize large lists quickly. You can change categories or archive items in groups.
Managing dozens of tasks? Enable bulk mode in settings or the task menu to edit multiple items simultaneously.
You can break complex goals into nested hierarchies by adding subtasks to tasks, and grouping tasks within projects.
All-in-One supports deep task organization. Use subtasks for steps, and projects to group your major life domains.
Build a hierarchy for your goals: Life Area -> Project -> Task -> Subtask. It's the ultimate way to stay organized.
The Ledger Summary gives you a birds-eye view of your total net balance across all personal ledgers.
See exactly how much money is 'in the air' with the Ledger Summary. It totals up all your active loans and debts.
Check your total financial commitments in the Ledger section to see if you are net positive or negative across all friends.
You can customize the colors of your spending and savings graphs in Finance Settings for better readability.
Make your financial data pop by picking custom colors for your expenditure and savings charts in the settings.
Head to Finance Settings to change the colors used in your monthly graphs and trend visualizations.
A budget is a spending limit; a savings goal is a target amount to set aside. Tracking both ensures stability.
Budgets keep your spending in check. Savings goals help you accumulate wealth. You can set both in the Finance module.
Understand your money: use budgets to prevent overspending and savings goals to build your future.
Use the search icon in the Finance section to find specific transactions by their name, category, or amount.
I can find any transaction in seconds. Use the search bar in the Finance tracker to filter by text or value.
Looking for a specific payment? The search feature in Finance will find it across all your history and ledgers.
In the Finance History, you can compare your current month's spending against previous months.
See your progress over time with monthly comparisons. We'll show you if you're spending more or less than last month.
Track your financial trends by looking at the month-over-month comparison charts in the Finance section.
To settle a ledger entry, simply add a transaction that brings the balance to zero. Then archive the ledger.
Paid back your debt? Log a transaction in that ledger to zero it out, then you can safely archive it.
Mark a ledger as settled by ensuring the balance is zeroed. Use the 'Settle' button for a quick summary of the final payment.
Track recurring expenses by creating a specific category for them and logging them regularly in the Finance tracker.
While not automated yet, you can easily log monthly bills by using the quick-add categories in your Finance module.
Keep on top of your bills by creating a 'Subscriptions' or 'Utilities' category and logging payments as they happen.
Grace days allow you to miss a day of a habit without breaking your streak. Useful for busy or difficult times.
Use grace days to keep your momentum alive when life gets in the way. They prevent one bad day from resetting your long streak.
Habit flexibility is key. Grace days allow you to skip a day while maintaining your 'Consistency' score.
Your discipline level increases as you consistently complete habits and tasks. High completion rates earn more XP.
I weigh your success in every area to calculate your Level. Consistency is the fastest way to rank up your profile.
Your rank reflects your habits. The more you do, the higher your Level and XP total will grow.
A streak is consecutive days; Momentum is a complex score weighing consistency across all your active habits.
Streaks are about one habit. Momentum is about your whole life system. I track both to give you a full picture of your discipline.
Momentum takes into account your total output, while streaks focus on single-habit continuity.
Success Driver is a correlation I find between your mood and your productivity. It shows which states lead to best days.
I analyze your logs to find 'Success Drivers'. For example, I might notice you're 50% more productive when you log a 'Happy' mood.
By linking mood and productivity data, I can show you exactly which emotional states correlate with your peak performance.
If I notice a decrease in sentiment or productivity over several days, I'll flag it as a mindset dip and suggest a break.
A mindset dip alert means your recent notes and task output show signs of burnout. I'll recommend some rest or focus shifts.
I watch for patterns of fatigue. If your consistency drops sharply, I'll flag it as a 'Mindset Dip' to help you recover faster.
You earn XP for almost every productive action: finishing habits, completing tasks, or reaching project milestones.
Every 'Win' in the app adds to your XP. Check off your list and log your routines to see your experience grow.
XP is your productivity currency. Log your life consistently to climb the levels and reach 'Master' status.
Leveling up reflects your growth in self-discipline. Higher levels unlock new badges and provide a sense of development.
As you level up, you'll earn badges that commemorate your journey. It's a visual record of your growing discipline.
Higher levels are a testament to your long-term consistency. Each rank up represents weeks or months of intentional living.
Badges are earned for specific milestones, like a 30-day habit streak or reaching a savings goal.
Check your profile to see your achievements. I unlock badges automatically as you hit major productivity and financial goals.
Earn 'Master' badges by being elite in specific areas like Finance, Habit Tracking, or Task Execution.
You can change your profile avatar in the Profile section. Pick an icon that represents your current focus.
Update your look! Select a new avatar and add your name to personalize your All-in-One experience.
Head to your Profile to pick a custom avatar and see your total XP and current Discipline Level.
In the Profile section, you can add a short bio or a personal mission statement to remind yourself of your 'Why'.
Set your mission! Use the bio field in your profile to write down your core purpose for using this app.
A personal bio helps keep your goals in focus. Add your mission statement in the Profile module settings.
Edge AI means processing happens on your device. This ensures your data is private, works offline, and responds instantly.
I am an 'Edge' AI. I don't use a server to think. Everything stays on your phone, making my responses fast and your data safe.
We use on-device intelligence to protect your privacy. This means you don't need internet and we don't need your data on our servers.
Yes, all your data is stored in a locally encrypted SQL database. No one can read it without your unique device key.
We use SQLCipher to encrypt your local database. Your notes, finances, and habits are protected by military-grade security.
Encryption is built-in. Even if your phone is lost, your data within this app remains locked and unreadable by unauthorized parties.
We avoid cloud sync to guarantee 100% privacy. We ensure that your most personal data can never be leaked or hacked from a server.
Local-only is a feature, not a bug. By not having a cloud backend, we eliminate the primary way personal data is stolen or misused.
Your life isn't a commodity. We don't use the cloud so that you maintain total, exclusive ownership of your own information.
Our local AI is highly optimized to run with minimal RAM. We use lightweight models that provide intelligence without slowing down your phone.
We prioritize performance. Our AI engine is designed to be lean, ensuring the app remains snappy even on older hardware.
Battery and RAM efficiency are key. We've optimized all our local processing to have a negligible impact on your device's resources.
We use the built-in Android Text-to-Speech engine. This allows me to talk to you without needing an internet connection.
My voice is generated entirely on your device. This keeps our conversations private and ensures I can always respond aloud, even offline.
Offline voice output is powered by your system's TTS settings. You can even change my voice speed and pitch in your Android settings.
The XS display size compacts the UI, allowing you to see more data on a single screen without scrolling.
If you want to see everything at a glance, the XS display setting is for you. It optimizes space for power users.
XS mode shrinks text and padding, giving you a dense, data-rich view of your life's progress.
The L display size increases text and icon sizes, making the app much easier to read and navigate.
For better accessibility, use the L display size. It provides large, clear elements and high contrast for easy use.
L mode is designed for readability. It increases the size of all UI components to ensure you never have to squint.
You can choose between Serif, Sans-Serif, and Monospace fonts in Appearance Settings to match your preference.
Pick your favorite font style! Whether you like a classic Serif look or a modern Monospace, we have options in settings.
Head to Appearance to customize your typography. You can change both the font family and the overall font size scale.
OLED mode uses true black backgrounds. On OLED screens, this saves battery by turning off pixels completely.
Pure Black (OLED) mode is beautiful and efficient. It reduces eye strain and extends battery life on modern devices.
Switch to OLED mode in Appearance Settings for a stunning true-black experience that's easy on both your eyes and your battery.
On Android 12+, you can enable Dynamic Colors to have the app's accent match your phone's wallpaper.
Enjoy a unified look with Dynamic Coloring. We'll pull colors from your system theme to make the app feel part of your device.
Toggle Dynamic Colors in settings to sync All-in-One's appearance with your system's Material You theme.
Every morning, I can provide a summary of your top 3 priority tasks and any habits you need to focus on.
The Morning Briefing is your daily plan. I highlight your most urgent goals to help you start the day with clarity.
I'll help you focus every morning by surfacing your 'Big Three' tasks and upcoming deadlines in your briefing.
Night planning helps you review what you accomplished today and set intentions for tomorrow before you sleep.
End your day right with a Night Planning session. It's the best way to clear your head and prepare for a productive tomorrow.
My Night Planning tool helps you reflect on your wins and map out your next day, reducing morning decision fatigue.
Auto-cleanup automatically deletes or archives old, unpinned notes after a set period to keep your workspace clutter-free.
Don't let your notes get messy. Enable Auto-Cleanup to automatically archive stale content that you haven't interacted with.
Keep your 'Second Brain' sharp! Use the auto-cleanup settings to prune unimportant notes after 30, 60, or 90 days.
If a project is falling behind its predicted schedule, I'll send an alert so you can adjust your focus.
My 'Deadline Risk' engine monitors your work speed. If you're likely to miss a date, I'll notify you with a priority alert.
I'll keep you on schedule. If your daily task velocity drops too low to meet your project goals, I'll let you know.
Smart sorting uses priority scores and schedules to ensure relevant items are always at the top of your list.
We use algorithms to bring the most important work to your attention. Smart sorting handles the organization so you don't have to.
Our sorting system weighs deadlines, task age, and priority levels to keep your home screen optimized for action.
Screenshot protection prevents other apps from taking screenshots of your private data within this app.
Enable this in Security to block all screen capture attempts. It's an extra layer of safety for your most sensitive notes and finances.
Protect your data from prying eyes! This setting makes the app's window invisible to screen recording and capture tools.
Biometric lock allows you to use your fingerprint or face recognition to unlock the app instead of typing a PIN.
Fast and secure: use your device's biometrics to protect your All-in-One vault with just a touch.
Navigate to Security Settings to enable Biometric Lock. It's the most convenient way to keep your data private and accessible.
Since we are offline and don't have your PIN on a server, we cannot recover it. Reinstalling is the only way (which clears data).
We have no 'forgot password' link because we have no cloud. Please keep your PIN safe, or use biometrics as a backup.
Your PIN is strictly local. For your safety, we cannot reset it. Always export a backup of your data occasionally!
The Security Audit reviews your current lock status, encryption, and protection settings to ensure your data is safe.
Run a security check in the settings to see if your vault is fully protected by PINs, biometrics, and encryption.
I'll help you audit your security. Check the main settings to see my report on your app's current protection level.
App timeout sets how long the app stays unlocked in the background before requiring your PIN again.
Customize your security: set a timeout for the app lock so it only re-locks after you've been away for a few minutes.
Control your lock frequency. Set a custom timeout duration in the Security menu to balance convenience and safety.
The Speed Dial is the expandable '+' button on the home screen that gives one-tap access to tasks, habits, and expenses.
Use the Floating Action Button (Speed Dial) to quickly log your day. It's the fastest way to add any type of data.
Tap the '+' icon to reveal the speed dial. It's designed for rapid entry of everything from a quick note to a new expense.
Long-pressing items provides quick shortcuts, like long-pressing the AI button to immediately start the voice assistant.
Save time with long-press! Try it on the AI button for voice mode, or on cards to reveal edit and delete options.
Every module has shortcuts. Long-press on lists or buttons to see hidden actions and speed up your workflow.
The navigation drawer (top left) lets you jump quickly between Habits, Finance, Tasks, Notes, and Settings.
Open the side menu to navigate the entire app. It's your home base for moving between different productivity modules.
The drawer is always available on the left. Use it to switch your focus from money management to your project roadmaps.
Icons in the top bar provide quick access to section-specific history, search, and additional settings.
Look at the header of each screen! You'll find context-aware icons for history, search, and data filtering.
The top bar is your toolkit. Each section has unique icons there to help you manage your history and settings efficiently.
You can find the Intelligent Feed in the top-right menu of the Home screen or the AI section.
Access your AI insights via the three-dot menu on the home screen or inside the All-in-One AI module.
Your personalized feed is just a tap away. Look for the 'Intelligent Feed' option in the main app menus.
A factory reset permanently deletes all your data, settings, and history, returning the app to its original state.
Need a clean slate? Use the Factory Reset in Data Management to wipe all encrypted databases from your device.
Warning: This action is irreversible. Factory resetting will remove every habit, note, and transaction you've logged.
You can find your current app version at the very bottom of the Settings screen.
Check the settings page footer for build information and your current All-in-One version number.
Stay updated! Your current version is displayed at the bottom of the main settings menu.
Data Synergy is how your mood, tasks, habits, and finance data interact to give you a complete picture of your life.
